about: A Python library of small helper functions for lists, dicts and text, modelled on Lodash.

prs.title: Slugs keep letters like ß, æ, ø and Ł
prs.broken: Making a web address slug deleted letters with no simple accent form, so Straße became strae and Łódź became odz.
prs.changed: Those letters are now turned into plain ones first, so the slugs read strasse and lodz.
prs.matters: Sites in German, Danish, Polish and other languages get readable web addresses.
